profile.name: Alice Chanthavong
profile.headline: Product engineer & UX systems designer — I design and build calm, decentralized tools for real organizations.
profile.bio:
I work with clinics, schools and small teams in Laos on software that has to survive bad connectivity and low trust in platforms. My focus is UX systems: bilingual interfaces, offline-first flows, and design tokens a local team can maintain after I leave.

This sample shows the personal portfolio shape: selected projects, evidence grades, and a contact path. The real version is signed by the key that owns the page.

projects.title: Mekong Care — patient record platform
projects.summary: Offline-tolerant records for three rural clinics: Laos-first bilingual UI, Lightning-based micro-payments for lab results, and a care-team inbox built on Nostr private groups.
projects.description: A record system designed for intermittent power and connectivity. The field team needed a queue that survives a dropped connection and a review flow that does not lose paper handoffs.

projects.title: Saisana School — enrollment & payments
projects.summary: Parent-facing enrollment flow with Lightning fee payment and bilingual notices.
projects.description: One enrollment form for families who mostly use a phone, with printable fallbacks for the school office.

projects.title: Sabai Marketplace
projects.summary: Peer-to-peer storefronts for local sellers; escrow UX and dispute flows.
projects.description: A small commerce prototype exploring how a buyer and seller can agree on a handoff without a central marketplace holding the money.
